meta.title: PantryButler - Your Smart Kitchen Companion
meta.description: Manage your recipes, pantry, grocery lists, and meal planning all in one place. PantryButler helps you organize your kitchen and cook with confidence.

hero.title: Intelligently Manage Your Recipes and Meal Plans
hero.subtitle: Organize your recipes, tag them, set timers for each step, even add images so you know exactly how mixed something should be. Compatible with Cooklang format. Import from URLs, Cooklang files, or public PantryButler recipes. Share your recipes publicly or embed them in your blog.

features.title: Core Features
features.subtitle: Comprehensive support for your kitchen life

recipeManagement.title: Recipe Management
recipeManagement.description: Create, edit, and organize your recipe collection. Support for detailed ingredient lists, step-by-step instructions with timers, and image uploads for each step

nutritionTracking.title: Automatic Nutrition Calculation
nutritionTracking.description: PantryButler automatically calculates comprehensive nutritional information for your recipes using the OpenNutrition database. Get detailed macronutrients, micronutrients, and daily value percentages for every recipe

importRecipes.title: Import from Anywhere
importRecipes.description: Import recipes from Cooklang files, URLs, or public PantryButler recipes. Compatible with Cooklang format for easy recipe sharing

stepTimers.title: Step-by-Step Timers
stepTimers.description: Set timers for each cooking step. Never miss a critical moment in your recipe with built-in timer notifications

mealPlanning.title: Meal Planning
mealPlanning.description: Plan weekly meals using calendar view. Easily schedule breakfast, lunch, and dinner to keep your diet organized

smartShopping.title: Smart Shopping Lists
smartShopping.description: Automatically generate shopping lists from recipes and meal plans. Intelligently merge duplicate ingredients to optimize your shopping

pantryManagement.title: Pantry Management
pantryManagement.description: Track your ingredient inventory and kitchen equipment. Know what you have to avoid duplicate purchases and waste

collaboration.title: Collaboration & Sharing
collaboration.description: Share recipes publicly or embed them in your blog, or collaborate with family members and roommates on meal planning together

privateKitchens.title: Private Kitchens
privateKitchens.description: Create your own private kitchen space and invite family members or roommates. Everyone can see what's available in the pantry and what's being cooked, making household meal coordination effortless

languages.title: Available in Multiple Languages
languages.subtitle: PantryButler is available in English, Spanish (Español), French (Français), Hindi (हिन्दी), Italian (Italiano), Albanian (Shqip), and Chinese (中文)
languages.description: Switch languages anytime using the language selector in the top navigation

cta.title: Ready to Get Started?
cta.subtitle: Set up your first kitchen and start managing recipes and planning meals. Completely free, no credit card required

support.title: Support PantryButler
support.description: PantryButler is free and open for everyone. If you find it useful, consider supporting the development to help us add more features and keep the service running.
